C1156.title: Youth Mode Flaw in So-Young Cosmetic Surgery App Persists Nine Months After Media Exposure
C1156.summary: The youth mode in the So-Young cosmetic surgery app contains a vulnerability that allows users to bypass restrictions simply by uninstalling and reinstalling the app. The app also lacks a mandatory login prompt, enabling unrestricted browsing under a guest identity. The issue was previously reported by state media, yet the vulnerability remains unaddressed nine months later.
